purpose: A plain navigation link. Used by the menu panel, the footer link columns and the legal-page anchor index.

props.label: 1-3 words observed
props.href: one of the six routes, '#', or a '/#anchor'
props.activeState: React adds aria-current="page" and Webflow's .w--current when href matches the current route

responsive.base: stacked lists inside the menu/footer columns
responsive.max-991px: the menu panel resizes (18rem -> 16.2rem open width, m19.js)
responsive.max-767px: the closed menu panel becomes 15.5rem wide with y 0.5rem (m19.js)

notes: Three links ship with .is-hide and are therefore invisible: Linkedin and Youtube in the menu, plus the two matching footer social links. The markup keeps them because the original does.
